title: Create AdminDashboard React component
description:
Create react_ui/src/components/AdminDashboard.tsx implementing the admin dashboard UI with multiple panels: trace viewer, metrics panel, log event feed, and usage report. Uses the admin API functions from client.ts.

Before editing, inspect:
- AGENTS.md
- docs/plans_tasks.md
- docs/operations.md
- docs/architecture.md
- docs/PLANS/ACTIVE/CHATBOT/README.md
- docs/PLANS/ACTIVE/CHATBOT/DISPATCH.md
- react_ui/src/api/client.ts (updated by task t.8 — understand all admin API functions, TypeScript types, and call patterns)
- Existing react_ui/src/components/ files (understand React patterns, component structure, and Tailwind dark-theme usage)

Do not infer APIs, constructor signatures, function names, module locations, or service topology from the task description alone. Inspect the referenced documents and existing implementation files first, then implement against the actual repository.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY react_ui/src/components/AdminDashboard.tsx. Do NOT modify any other file under any circumstance. Do NOT update documentation, READMEs, operations guides, or any code outside the listed path. If you believe other files need updating, ignore that impulse and finish the task with only the listed file modified. Out-of-scope edits will cause the task to be rejected.

Implementation details:

1. A React functional component `AdminDashboard` with Tailwind dark-theme styling (bg-gray-900, text-gray-100):
   - Main layout: a tabbed interface with four tabs: Traces, Metrics, Logs, Usage.
   - On mount, calls fetchAdminHealth() to verify the admin API is reachable. Shows a green/red status indicator.

2. Traces Tab:
   - A scrollable table with columns: Trace ID (truncated), Session ID (truncated), Model, Task Class, Latency (ms), Tokens, Cost. Each row clickable to expand inline detail.
   - Expanded detail panel shows: full prompt (code-style, max-height scrollable), routing decision JSON, retrieval snippets list, pipeline steps with durations, cost breakdown.
   - Pagination controls for page navigation.
   - Optional Session ID filter input.
   - Loading state (skeleton or spinner) and empty state ("No traces captured yet").

3. Metrics Tab:
   - Global metrics summary card: total requests, total tokens, total cost (formatted as USD), average latency.
   - Per-model metrics table: columns for model ID, requests, tokens (prompt/completion), cost, avg/P50/P95/P99 latency.
   - Bar chart or visual representation of latency percentiles per model (can be simple CSS bars, no charting library required).
   - Loading and empty states.

4. Logs Tab:
   - Filter bar: event type dropdown (all, memory_write, contradiction, failed_retrieval), optional session ID input, optional since timestamp.
   - Scrollable event feed showing each event as a card: event type badge (colored), timestamp, optional session/turn IDs, severity badge, and expandable details JSON.
   - Pagination controls (limit/offset).
   - Loading and empty states ("No events recorded").

5. Usage Tab:
   - Usage report card with totals: sessions, turns, tokens, cost.
   - Per-model usage breakdown table: model, sessions, turns, tokens, cost.
   - Loading and empty states.

6. Use text/emoji for icons and visual indicators (no icon library). Use standard React hooks (useState, useEffect). Import admin API functions from client.ts.
